blocks.x: If you’re already using Rogaine® or minoxidil, a DHT-focused blocking shampoo can be a smart addition to your hair routine. Minoxidil works to support hair growth, while a DHT shampoo helps cleanse and support a healthy scalp environment while strengthening the hair you already have. Think of it as a team effort: minoxidil handles the growth-focused treatment, while your shampoo helps create the foundation for stronger, thicker, healthier-looking hair.

That’s where Pete & Pedro DHT Defense Shampoo comes in. It’s packed with hair- and scalp-supporting ingredients like saw palmetto, pumpkin seed extract, rosemary, caffeine, biotin, niacin, panthenol, tea tree, peppermint, aloe, argan oil, and 20+ botanical extracts. Instead of relying on one trendy ingredient, DHT Defense takes a multi-angle approach—supporting the scalp, strengthening and conditioning existing hair, and helping hair look thicker, fuller, and healthier. It’s the perfect dht blocking shampoo to round out a serious thinning-hair routine.
